correction: V3 incorrectly treated the complete daily contract interval as a near-expiry resolver window and replaced its Hermes feed URL as the future Gamma panel changed. V4 freezes exact feed identities at process start, defers newly discovered feed symbols to the next cohort, and permits signals only in the final 300 seconds defined by the largest pre-registered checkpoint.

source_contract.rule_identity: exact decoded pythdata.app/explore/<feed-symbol> path in the immutable market rule
source_contract.catalog_identity: exact attributes.symbol match from the Pyth Hermes Core feed catalog; fuzzy and search-page matches are vetoed
source_contract.trigger_transport: one process-lifetime frozen Pyth Hermes Core SSE cohort
source_contract.diagnostic_transport: Polymarket equity_prices RTDS; retained in WAL but forbidden from creating signals
source_contract.new_feed_after_freeze: defer market to the next evidence cohort

observation_contract.outside_window: raw source capture only; no signal and no required fresh resolver tick
observation_contract.inside_window: fresh exact source tick and complete feed coverage required
observation_contract.transport_gap: hard evidence failure at all times

model_contract.entry_rule: fair lower bound - executable ask - doubled fees - slippage must be strictly positive
model_contract.probe_interpretation: execution/calibration observation, never a claimed trade

signals.additional_trigger: live exact-feed Pyth sign flip around the certified price-to-beat inside the final 300 seconds only

evaluation.multiple_testing: Holm across resolver source, checkpoint, side and latency
evaluation.null_outcome: The exact Pyth resolver residual may be fully reflected in the executable quote.
